serverMetadata.instructions: speedread: fast, token-budgeted code reading. Prefer its tools over shell cat/sed/head/grep/find/ls and over one-file-at-a-time reads. Batch every file, range and symbol you need into ONE `read` call (`path`, `path:A-B`, `path#Symbol`, `#Symbol`, globs); oversized files come back as skeletons you expand by symbol instead of being cut off. `search` hits show their enclosing function/class; `trace` follows callers, callees, references and implementations; `map` orients you in a repo. After editing a file, read `path@etag` (etag from the `==>` header) to see only what changed.

data.content: Bug report: app.config.from_prefixed_env() raises KeyError for a nested variable such as `FLASK_NEW__KEY=1` when `NEW` is not in the config yet; per the documentation, missing intermediate dicts should be created. Find and fix the bug in the library code (do not modify tests). Verify with `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests --deselect tests/test_cli.py::test_get_version`. When done, reply with a one-line summary of the fix.

Find and fix the bug in the library code (do not modify tests). Verify with `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests --deselect tests/test_cli.py::test_get_version`. When done, reply with a one-line summary of the fix.
